actions.closeBody: Closing is final. The contract moves to closed and accepts no further certificates.
actions.cancelBody: A cancelled contract never takes effect and cannot be reinstated.
actions.terminateBody: Termination ends an active contract early and cannot be undone.

terms.lockedHint: Commercial terms are read-only once a contract is closed, cancelled or terminated.

retention.heading: Retention terms
retention.noneHint: Retention is deducted from each certificate until the cap is reached.
retention.rateHint: Deducted from each certificate. Enter a percentage, for example 5.
retention.capHint: Maximum held, as a percentage of the contract value.
retention.splitOnPcHint: Share of retention released at practical completion. The rest follows at final account.
retention.releasedAtHint: Leave empty until the final release is made.
retention.failed: Could not save the retention terms.

advances.heading: Advance terms
advances.noneHint: An advance is paid up front and recovered from later certificates.
advances.recoveryRateHint: Recovered from each certificate. Enter a percentage, for example 10.
advances.removeBody: The term is deleted from the contract. Certificates already issued are not changed.
advances.removeFailed: Could not remove the advance term.
advances.failed: Could not add the advance term.

guarantees.heading: Guarantees
guarantees.noneHint: Record performance, advance payment and retention guarantees here.
guarantees.typeHint: For example PERFORMANCE, ADVANCE_PAYMENT or RETENTION.
guarantees.issuerHint: The bank or institution that issued it.
guarantees.lapsedHint: The cover has lapsed. Update the status so the record matches reality.
guarantees.lapsedSummary: {count, plural, one {# guarantee has expired without being updated.} other {# guarantees have expired without being updated.}}
guarantees.expiryBeforeIssue: Expiry cannot be before the issue date

milestones.heading: Milestones

ipa.countLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}

create.title: New payment application
create.periodHint: The period this claim covers. Both dates are optional.
create.endBeforeStart: The period end cannot be before its start

detail.numberedOnApproval: An application number is assigned when it is approved for submission.
detail.frozenHint: Lines are frozen while this application awaits internal approval. Returning it for revision reopens them.
detail.finalHint: This application is final. Nothing about it can change.
detail.stuckHint: This application was returned for revision. Its lines can still be corrected, but the API does not accept a resubmission from this state â€” the only way forward is to cancel it and create a replacement. Raised with the backend as C14.

actions.submitTitle: Submit this application to the client?
actions.submitBody: A submitted application is immutable. Its lines and deductions can no longer be changed, and there is no command to bring it back.
actions.returnBody: It goes back to the author and its lines become editable again. The approval step will have to be repeated.
actions.cancelBody: A cancelled application cannot be reinstated.
actions.approveHint: Approving assigns the permanent application number the client will see.
actions.failed: The command could not be completed.

items.heading: Claimed lines
items.noneHint: Claim BOQ lines to build up this periodâ€™s valuation.
items.noLines: This contractâ€™s BOQ has no priced leaf lines to claim.
items.allClaimed: Every line on this BOQ is already claimed on this application.
items.unpriced: no rate â€” cannot be claimed
items.cumulativeHint: The total claimed to date on this line, including this period â€” not this period alone.
items.serverDerived: The period quantity and amount are calculated by the server from what was previously certified. They appear once the line is added.
items.removeBody: The line is removed from this application. Nothing else is affected.

deductions.heading: Deductions
deductions.noneHint: Retention and advance recovery are deducted from the period total.
deductions.typeHint: For example RETENTION, ADVANCE_RECOVERY or TAX.
deductions.basisHint: The amount the rate applies to. Usually the period total.
deductions.rateHint: Optional. Entering one shows the resulting amount below.
deductions.authoredHere: The API stores this amount exactly as entered â€” it derives nothing from the contract terms. Check it against the contract before submitting.
deductions.removeBody: The deduction is removed and the net payable increases accordingly.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.countLabel: {count, plural, =0 {No receipts} one {# receipt} other {# receipts}}
receipts.emptyHint: Record money received from a client, then allocate it against certificates.

create.title: Record a receipt
create.referenceHint: The payment advice or transfer reference, so this can be traced later.
create.amountNotPositive: The amount must be greater than zero
create.loadFailed: Could not load the client list.

detail.overAllocatedHint: More has been allocated than was received on this receipt. Remove an allocation to bring it back into balance. This state is reachable because the API accepts a negative allocation (C17, issue #14).

allocations.heading: Allocations
allocations.none: This receipt has not been allocated yet.
allocations.noneHint: Allocate it against the certificates it pays.
allocations.noCertificates: This client has no effective certificates to allocate against.
allocations.not-positive: The amount must be greater than zero
allocations.exceeds-balance: That is more than the unallocated balance on this receipt
allocations.removeBody: The amount returns to the receiptâ€™s unallocated balance.
allocations.statusCaveat: A certificateâ€™s paid/unpaid status is not shown: the API compares payments against the gross certified total rather than the net, so a fully settled certificate never reads as paid (C7, issue #11).
allocations.currencyMismatch: This certificate is in {certificateCurrency} but the receipt is in {receiptCurrency}. The API does not check this â€” allocate only if that is deliberate.

wizard.title: Issue Payment Certificate

step1.title: Certificate Details
step1.description: Select the certificate outcome and provide supporting context.
step1.rejectionReasonPlaceholder: State why this application is being rejected
step1.statusRequired: Select a certificate outcome to continue

step2.title: Line-Item Certification
step2.description: Adjust the certified quantity for each claimed line. A reason is required when the certified amount differs from the claimed amount.
step2.varianceReasonPlaceholder: Why does the certified quantity differ from the claimed quantity?
step2.varianceReasonRequired: A variance reason is required when certified quantity differs from claimed
step2.certifiedRequired: Enter a certified quantity for every line

step3.title: Deductions & Review
step3.description: Review estimated deductions, add any additional charges, then issue the certificate.
step3.autoDeductionsNote: Retention and advance recovery amounts are applied automatically by the server.
step3.serverComputeNote: Final amounts are computed by the server on issue.
step3.issueFailed: Could not issue the certificate. Please check all fields and try again.

wizard.effectiveCertWarning: An effective certificate already exists for this application. Issuing a new one will replace it.

list.heading: Payment Certificates
list.none: No certificate has been issued for this application.
list.notEffectiveHint: This certificate is not yet effective.

detail.paymentNote: Allocation details are recorded on payment receipts. Use the receipts ledger to view payments applied to this certificate.
detail.notEffectiveBanner: This certificate has been issued but is not yet effective. Make it effective to replace the current one.
detail.noEffectiveCertNote: There is no effective certificate to supersede. This certificate will become effective when the supersession command is run.
detail.noDeductionsHint: The net certified amount is the same as the gross.
detail.superseded: This certificate was superseded on {date}. It is a historical record and must not be paid against.
detail.supersededWithReason: This certificate was superseded on {date} — {reason}. It is a historical record and must not be paid against.
detail.grossMismatch: This certificate records a gross total of {stated}, but its own lines add up to {summed}. Nothing on the server reconciles the two, so both are shown as recorded — raised as issue #12.

supersession.businessImpact: The current effective certificate ({currentRef}) will be superseded. Certificate {newRef} will become the effective certificate for this application.
supersession.reasonHint: This will be permanently recorded on the superseded certificate.
supersession.failed: Could not complete the supersession. Please try again.

settlement.heading: Payment
settlement.overAllocatedHint: More has been allocated to this certificate than it is worth.
settlement.derivedNote: Measured against the net certified amount. The API's own payment status compares against the gross total and cannot report a certificate with deductions as paid — raised as issue #11.
settlement.unavailable: The amount paid against this certificate could not be loaded. The certificate itself is unaffected.
